The profile

About Shortreed Crescent

Shortreed Crescent is a residential curve in Milton's Coates neighbourhood, a pocket of the town that sits east of the escarpment and north of the Derry Road corridor. The street bends rather than runs, which gives it a quieter interior rhythm than the through-roads that frame the area.

Own on Shortreed Crescent? Typical is $775K.
Value my home

The homes here

The housing stock on Shortreed Crescent is townhouse throughout. Every recorded sale on the street falls into that single category, and no detached, semi-detached, or condominium units appear in the mix. The crescent's short length and single housing type give it a consistent built character from end to end.

Trade patterns

Because the street's own numbers are suppressed, the pricing reference is the wider Coates context rather than anything Shortreed-specific.

The rental side is separate and equally modest. Suitability is discussed elsewhere on this page.

Comparable homes nearby

Sold-to-ask sits just under parity, which points to modest negotiation room rather than a market where buyers are routinely paying at or above ask. The balance is close to level, and the neighbourhood read is one of steady, unremarkable trade rather than sharp movement in either direction.
